description: Soil grid of the MATSIRO land-surface model in MIROC-ES3. Soil heat and soil water are calculated on a common six-layer grid with interfaces at 0, 0.05, 0.25, 1, 2, 4 and 14 m below the surface (layer thicknesses 0.05, 0.20, 0.75, 1, 2 and 10 m). Snow has a variable number of layers, from one to three, depending on the snow water equivalent.
